<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR showing a single aromatic multiplet integrating to 10 H at ~7.5 ppm, the compound is most consistent with biphenyl (C₁₂H₁₀), which has two equivalent phenyl rings giving ten aromatic protons. The corresponding SMILES is “c1ccccc1-c2ccccc2”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1-c2ccccc2</final_answer>
